# <center>ReSync - Game Engine for Minecraft</center>


Design server GUIs, create custom items, blocks, and armor, customize tabs and scoreboards, and control all events in a user-friendly editor. 

Visual Editing
Replace 50+ config files with easy and dynamic node-based visual editing, the right way.

# ReSync Systems

• Custom WorldGen

• World Management

• Content Creation

• GUI Designer

• Tab Designer

• Scoreboard Designer

### Powered by over 1,200 nodes, ReSync utilizes Remotely as its client.

***

# Remotely
You need Remotely in order to use ReSync. Remotely is available as a Minecraft mod or a native Desktop App, and both are cross-platform.
